acceptanceCriteria: Decide (spec) whether a per-test UnexpectedError is FAILED-with-error-kind or UNKNOWN; record the requirement.
A real Minitest witness with one raising test and one passing test produces the specified per-case outcomes; focused test pins it.
body: Found by CEM dynamic lane V1-0592 (PR beamfall/corvint#1003, head 1398a8c24, base origin/main 7c9a52d90, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/dynamic-2026-10-17/. Suspected defect: a Minitest test that raises (UnexpectedError) becomes UNKNOWN and makes the entire run incomplete, although the runner attributes the error to one named test. Expected: FAILED with an error kind for that case; other cases keep their outcomes. Actual: whole-run UNKNOWN.
title: Minitest UnexpectedError maps to UNKNOWN and voids the whole run instead of a FAILED error-kind case
